items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Account Takeover via Session Identity Flaw
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch an active session to a different customer account, leading to account takeover.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This stored XSS vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability addressed in APSB26-92 could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability specific to Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves 13 vulnerabilities, including eight critical ones, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical, unauthenticated, zero-interaction flaw in the webhooks component of Adobe Commerce can lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows attackers to upload unrestricted files to the server, potentially leading to privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow for privilege escalation by injecting malicious scripts in the backend.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows for security feature bypass and requires no authentication for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: Another critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that enables a security feature bypass and can be exploited without authentication.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access.
